title: HST ACS/WFC Parallel-Trail Estimator Audit
question: How stable is a fitted parallel-trail suppression estimator across archive reprocessing, repeated exposures and exposure deletion?
gap: An independent archive-product verification; not a replacement for CALACS or a new PCTETAB.
dataMode: real public HST ACS/WFC FLT/FLC products
novelty: An independent archive-product verification; not a replacement for CALACS or a new PCTETAB.
methodology: Source detection uses photutils DAOStarFinder on background-subtracted FLC images. Per-source profiles are extracted only along the parallel-readout axis and fit to I(d)=A exp(-d/L)+c independently for FLT and FLC. Suppression is 1-(A_FLC L_FLC)/(A_FLT L_FLT). The September audit verifies every input byte, clusters repeated detector coordinates before resampling, reports per-exposure and leave-one-exposure-out medians, and compares the current CALACS products with the prior manifest snapshot.
assumptions: Readout-corner geometry is inferred from the CCDAMP/CCDCHIP header keywords using a documented, explicit convention (see docs/ASSUMPTIONS_AND_LIMITATIONS.md), not independently re-derived from CALACS source.
Trails are modelled as a single empirical exponential (Massey et al. 2010; Anderson & Bedin 2010 form), not a multi-trap-species physical simulation.
A 4-pixel buffer reduces, but does not prove elimination of, PSF-wing contamination before trail fitting.
limitations: First-release, bounded scope: an independent archive-product check, not a replacement for CALACS or a new PCTETAB.
The sample is three consecutive exposures of one field; 38 accepted measurements reduce to 34 coordinate clusters and cannot represent ACS/WFC as a population.
Only the parallel estimator is analyzed. The serial extraction helper is tested software but is not used for the published real-data result.
reports/report.tex could not be compiled to PDF in this environment (no local LaTeX toolchain); only structural completeness was verified.
